newsitem.title: Austria: Austrian shares end firm after range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end firm after range-bound trade.

text.p: 1220 GMT - Austrian shares ended ahead on Thursday after trading within a claustrophobic range on low turnover, with only Verbund and VA Stahl seeing any volume.
* September ATX future up 7.1 points at 1,033.1.
* 10 ATX shares up, nine down, two unchanged.
* Top gainer chip maker AMS, up 4.03 percent at 697 schillings.
* Leading decliner Lenzing, down 2.52 percent at 658.
* Vienna Bourse index up 0.14 percent at 403.84. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 254
